variants.candidate: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Earth gives it weight, so whatever you claim needs keeping. As a friction, providing outgrows your strength, and you take on another venture while you guard every saving. Over time you carry more than you finish.
variants.original: Earth is your Action, and as a friction, it is holding past your means: too many commitments owned, maintained, and defended at once, each taxing energy you no longer have spare. Everything you keep charges rent on you.

variants.candidate: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Wood makes it a reach that keeps going once started. Running over, you hold your way against a peer's advice, or treat shared ground as yours alone. You keep your way and lose the people beside you.
variants.original: Wood is your Body, and running over, it is more growing force than your life gives outlets: restlessness, overcommitment, energy that starts five things just to spend itself.

variants.candidate: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Here Water turns it deep, and understanding settles in you before words do. As a friction, the taking in runs ahead of use, so you read one more thing instead of deciding and stay sheltered past the need.
variants.original: Water is your Mind, and as a friction, it is intake past the point of use: one more book, one more opinion, reflection turning into stalling. More input now costs you clarity instead of adding it.

variants.candidate: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Lit by Fire, it runs warm, so nothing you feel waits. As a friction, it never shuts. You please people as much as you prove them wrong, and you pay for every word with sleep you skip.
variants.original: Fire is your Expression, and as a friction, it is visibility outrunning capacity: announcing early, performing energy you do not have, saying yes on stage and paying for it offstage.

variants.candidate: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Metal turns it exact, a line over your growth. As a friction, the line turns inward, and you push past the task rather than keep your rank. You become the one judge you never satisfy.
variants.original: Metal is your Order, and as a friction, it is correction landing harder than you can absorb: every rule met, every critique taken, until standards stop shaping you and start shrinking you. The harshest voice you hear ends up being your own.
